card.name: New dosing interval after a change
card.fires_on: The interval word (every, once, twice, weeks, Q) right after a phrase like 'increase the frequency to' or 'switch to every 4'. It marks the new schedule being switched to.

modes.label: Switching dosing interval
modes.description: Interval words completing a change of schedule, such as every 4 weeks or twice a day.
modes.example: Adult patients currently receiving RYBREVANT FASPRO at an every 2-week dosing regimen may switch to an every 4<<-week>> dosing regimen at their next scheduled dose

modes.label: Changed course with instead
modes.description: The word instead after a shift in direction in general prose.
modes.example: China changed course and sought<< instead>> to establish cordial relations with Middle Eastern

card.writes: It favors words about no longer doing something or doing it differently, such as 'instead' and Chinese 'no longer'.
card.plain: It lights up on the word that names the new schedule when a label says to change how often a drug is given.
